reference.observation: Unmodified public notification.useNotification and App/useApp; six placements, local/shared prefix, normal/nested/reset scopes, aliases/cssVar, statuses/close/actions. All raw cases and live changes precede nativeStyle counterparts with existing public close24/padding0 and wrapping guards. Raw stale status classes during prefix changes remain separate from refreshedTransitions public same-key open counterparts with duration0; this is not timing parity. Native canonical status backgrounds, top-layer viewport, motion/queue/focus/timing and minimum close target remain existing contracts.
